incident: live serving under-delivery after the 965-row re-stamp changed HNSW graph topology
discovered: post-cut-over live probe: query 5 returned 6/10 then 5/10 hits with a bit-identical top-1 score while the served chunk-id set was proven identical (965 ids)

root_cause.mechanism: the serving filter (embed_rev + VALIDATED/scope) applies AFTER the ANN traversal; rejected candidates are not replaced; 3378 SUGGESTED rev2-stamped chunks can exhaust the candidate budget in SUGGESTED-dense neighborhoods, returning fewer than LIMIT rows
root_cause.pre_existing: yes - same structure existed pre-cut-over with the rev filter reversed; the re-stamp only changed graph topology, making a previously-lucky query unlucky

diagnosis_evidence: EXPLAIN shows Index Scan using ix_document_chunks_embedding with post Filter ((embedding IS NOT NULL) AND (embed_rev = 2) AND scope branches)
fake-vector delivery test pre-REINDEX: limit 10 -> 8 rows via index; seq scan -> 10
prepared-statement (JDBC generic plan) probe with a SUGGESTED-dense vector: 0 rows (iterative off)
direct query same probe: 2 rows (off) -> 10 rows (strict_order)
exact nearest passing row at distance 0.2065; 965 rows pass the filter

remedy.op: pg_terminate_backend(5444) - one idle pooled 'PostgreSQL JDBC Driver' backend so the app pool reconnects under the new DB default

verification.live_app_final: 50/50 hits across the 5-probe battery, every top-1 score bit-identical to the pre-cut-over baseline (probe_final.json)
